label: ITS
description: GIC ITS (Interrupt Translation Service) 寄存器

registers.name: GITS_PARTIDR
registers.description: Set PARTID and PMG Register。GIC ITS 寄存器。

fields.name: PMG
fields.description: PMG value used when ITS accesses memory. Bits not needed to represent PMG values in the range 0 to PMG_MAX are RES0.

fields.name: PARTID
fields.description: PARTID value used when ITS accesses memory. Bits not needed to represent PARTID values in the range 0 to PARTID_MAX are RES0.
